outcome.answer: Two papers describe GNNs as proxies for SDP relaxations. One studies architectures for recovering solutions to linear SDPs and finds that a more expressive model can emulate first-order solver updates; its predictions can also warm-start the solver [1]. The other proposes a Max-Cut-specific proxy that predicts primal- and dual-feasible SDP solutions, is trained without solved SDP labels, and is used to reduce bounding costs in exact branch-and-bound [2].
